verdict.rationale: Release notes say users can paste images straight into the new-task composer as attachments. That covers attaching a screenshot or mockup to a task. Nothing shows built-in markup or annotation, or that the attached image drives the agent's visual implementation. Missing for 10: in-app screenshot annotation/markup, documentation of how image attachments are passed to and used by the agent, attaching images to existing tasks or comments, independent or hands-on corroboration.
